local.body: Hatchlight looks at your computer and picks the version of each model that runs best on it. Download it once, and every picture after that costs nothing and never leaves your machine. Models run on Windows, on Linux with an NVIDIA card, and on Macs with Apple Silicon.
local.cardLabel: Example: what Hatchlight finds on a desktop computer
local.title: Runs on your computer, free.
meta.description: Make images and videos with many AI models, side by side. Run them on your own computer for free, or bring the services you already pay for. Free and open source.
meta.ogDescription: Make pictures and videos with many AI models, side by side, on your own graphics card or your own keys. Free and open source.
meta.title: Hatchlight — many AI models, side by side
server.access.body: Use it on your home network, or from anywhere with Tailscale, which we recommend: HTTPS, and nothing opened to the internet. A domain behind Caddy or a Cloudflare Tunnel works too.
server.access.title: Reach it from anywhere
server.accounts.body: Each person signs in and sees only their own pictures. You decide who may train LoRAs and who may spend on paid models, up to a monthly limit.
server.accounts.title: Accounts, kept apart
server.agents: Coming next: connecting AI agents to a shared server.
server.needs.body: Linux or Windows with Docker, an NVIDIA card with driver 570 or newer, and the NVIDIA Container Toolkit. Without a card, models run on the processor, more slowly.
server.needs.title: You need:
server.note: Put Hatchlight on a home server or NAS with an NVIDIA card, and everyone at home or on your team uses it in the browser, each with their own account. One graphics card and one set of models, shared fairly.
server.quickNote: The second line builds the image. From the next release, a ready image comes from GitHub and that line can be skipped. Then open the address and enter the setup code from docker compose logs.
server.safety.body: Saved API keys are encrypted, the server's data is readable by the server alone, and the app runs in its container without root or special permissions.
server.safety.title: Careful by default
server.title: Run it on your own server.
services.note: Connect the services you use and pay them directly, at their prices. Hatchlight adds nothing on top.
services.title: Bring your own keys. No middleman.
